en: "Don't get the wrong idea, brat."
"Listen. I'll tell you just one thing."
"If you're grateful to me, then{n} from now on fight as I order. If{n} I tell you to die, you die. Got it?"
"From today, I'm your master.{n} You're not a person, you're a doll.{n} So I hold first claim of ownership."
"Got it?"
"Yup, okay!"
"I'm fine with dying any time!"
"I'll do anything you order!"
"I belong to you!"
"That'll do..."
"People have the right to choose{n} their own path. I chose the path{n} of going with you."
"What for?"
"To treat you."
"As you can see, I'm in perfect health."
"No, what needs treatment is your{n} heart. Your heart, afflicted by{n} the sickness called evil."
"If someone afflicted by the sickness{n} of evil is right before my eyes, I{n} want to treat them with these hands."
"You're nuts."
"Oh well."
"An army chaplain will come in handy.{n} If you want to tag along,{n} suit yourself."
"Oh! Thank you so much!{n} You really are just the person{n} I thought you were!"
"But I'm fickle. If I decide you're{n} in the way, I'll toss you out at{n} once. Or I might cut you down."
"After all, they tell me I'm afflicted{n} by a sickness of the heart{n} called evil."
"I'll just have you slaughter enemy{n} soldiers, with that 'power of God'{n} of yours."
"You must not hurt people!{n} Endure violence, and only ever{n} defend yourself. That is what matters!"
"Yeah, yeah, I get it!"
"I must go."
"The one clue to knowing myself{n} is simply to move forward..."
"Please. Will you take me with you?"
"What?"
"What will you do, Lt. {hero:6}?{n} It is a Machine Soldier, after all.{n} We can't trust it carelessly...?"
"No. Either way, we're short on{n} fighting strength ourselves. I'd{n} take a hand from a cat right now."
"True..."
"Very well."
"Then take up duty as my bodyguard.{n} If you can do that,{n} I'll take you along."
"I must go. For that, I will even{n} obey the word of a human."
"Good, it's settled."
"But if things get dicey, I'll leave{n} you behind any time.{n} Just remember that much."
"That is acceptable."
"Hmph. So now I owe you one, is that it?"
"No. It was me they were after."
"They were afraid of me."
"Afraid that I would have my fated{n} meeting and regain my will to fight."
"Well, what do you say?{n} Will you let me join your party?"
"Let's see...{n} The more fighters, the better.{n} If you want to tag along, suit yourself."
"Thank you."
"But! If you're coming along,{n} I'm the leader, period.{n} You'll obey my orders."
"And that powerful might of yours:{n} whatever happens, never turn{n} it on me. Got it?"
"Understood. As long as you are human."
"What a weird thing to say..."
"I see. So you're in a pitiful spot."
"I'll fight on even if I'm alone!{n} I'll carry on the pride of the Rhodes{n} Heavy MG Battalion all by myself!"
"I don't need your pity!"
"That's not it."
"If you want to fight that badly,{n} I'm saying I'll give you the{n} battlefield you're looking for."
"From today you're a free soldier.{n} I'm hiring you. Fight all you like,{n} till the enemy before you dies, or you do."
"Care to explain?"
"By our strength alone, we could{n} never hope to reach the center{n} of this island..."
"But with you!"
"So thinking, we first challenged you{n} to battle, as a test of strength..."
"Listen to you talk..."
"Easterners are shrewd. You can never{n} tell what they're thinking.{n} That's what I've heard."
"I beg of you!"
"Will you not let us join you{n} as your companions!?"
"...All right."
"But if you show even a hint of{n} anything suspicious, I'll cut you{n} both down without a second thought."
"Oh, we are most grateful!"
"From now on, please ask of us{n} whatever you wish."
"We will surely prove useful."
"Hey, you there, old man."
"Y-you mean to kill me!?"
"Of course. You're the enemy."
"I don't care about squabbles between{n} armies! All I need is to be able{n} to do my research!"
"...I'll put some of my research{n} to work for you lot! It's a trade.{n} You won't lose by it!"
"Tch.{n} This old man kills even my urge to kill him."
"Well, do as you like.{n} But you will cooperate."
"Mm!{n} Give and take, eh!"
"What an oddball old man..."
"Big trouble, {name:6}!"
"What's the maaatter?{n} Did a bee sting you or something?"
"You're as carefree as ever, huh."
"Just now, on my patrol, I ran into{n} a peddler, and he told me{n} Rheinmetall has started a war."
"Oh my? With which country?"
"With the Kingdom of Rhodes,{n} of all places."
"Whaaat!?"
"...Oh, you're fibbing agaaain!{n} Rheinmetall and Rhodes have{n} a military alliance, don't they?"
"I may be a country girl raised on{n} an island, but I know that much,{n} you knooow."
"That's why it's a shock. Rheinmetall{n} broke that alliance and declared{n} war at the same time, they say."
"Oh, how scary. But whyyy?"
"Who knows what big powers think."
"Anyway, Rhodes is a small country.{n} To defend itself, it'll pull out{n} of this island soon enough."
"To think a war is really starting..."
"Yeah. For the last 20 years or so,{n} the continent of Europea kept up{n} a peace, on the surface at least."
"With this island rising up, the{n} nations' hidden rivalries all burst{n} into the open at once, it seems."
"But if Hector found out,{n} I'm sure it would make him sad..."
"Can't be helped. As long as there{n} are armies, war will never go away."
"No, even without armies, as long{n} as there are nations, maybe as long{n} as there are people, war won't end."
"Right?"
"If that's so, it's just too sad..."
"Big trouble, {name:6}!"
"Oh my, did a bee sting you agaaain?"
"What do you mean, 'again'?{n} 'Again', she says!"
"Never mind that, this is big.{n} Seems even the Holy Nation of Assyria{n} declared war on the Kingdom of Rhodes."
"Oh my, really?"
"And that's not all. The Rheinmetall{n} navy and your own Folgore navy have{n} both sent ships to this island."
"Ships? You mean warships?"
"Yeah. They're finally getting serious{n} about grabbing the Almighty Treasure,{n} the power of the gods asleep here."
"The Third Great Europea War could{n} break out any moment. The power of{n} the gods would be the ultimate weapon."
"No, it doesn't even have to be{n} the power of the gods."
"With a few of the Machine Gods the{n} old Ordoba used, even a small kingdom{n} could take on a great power just fine."
"Besides Rheinmetall and Folgore,{n} other nations will keep sending{n} their armies to this island..."
"Then we must hurry all the mooore."
"We have to find the power of the gods{n} and throw it away forever, out of{n} human reach, before it's too late."
"Before the blood of many is shed."
"Let's rest a bit, then set out.{n} We don't have much time left."
"Yes, let's do our best."
"Big trouble, {name:6}!"
"Oh my, oh my, oh my.{n} Did a bee sting you yet agaaain?"
"No... that's not it..."
"No time for playing dumb. Every army{n} is on the move for real. The waters{n} round the Steel Island teem with warships."
"Depending on how things go on this{n} island, it's the start of the{n} Third Great Europea War."
"Just like bees..."
"Huh? More playing dumb?"
"A swarm of bees gathering at flowers.{n} They always act as a group, and they{n} face outside foes with their lives."
"But sadly..."
"Bees kept by people have even the{n} honey they worked so hard to gather{n} taken away from them by people."
"So the honey's the power of the gods?"
"Let's go."
"We are human. There must be a way{n} to live that is different from bees."
"Yeah. The fleets on the Sea of Avalon{n} are only glaring at each other for now.{n} The ground forces haven't pulled out."
"...Meaning even with the fleets there,{n} they won't be shelling us{n} with their naval guns."
"We should still have a chance now.{n} Before the fleets really move, we've{n} got to gather the twelve rings somehow."
"I'm sorry, Diana."
"What's this, all of a sudden?"
"You're a bounty collector. Times like{n} this should be your chance to cash in,{n} yet I've dragged you along on my job..."
"It's fine."
"Besides, I'm no bounty collector.{n} I'm a bounty hunter.{n} Kindly don't get that wrong."
"Oh my, I'm sooo sorry!"
"Well, never mind. Let's rest,{n} then head out."
"{name:6}! Look at that!"
"That light..."
"It seems someone got the ring{n} before us, doesn't iiit?"
"What do we do?"
"We mean to collect them all, so{n} we're bound to meet them sooner{n} or later."
"I do hope they'll be willing{n} to cooperate with us..."
"Oh my? Mr. {hero:6}!{n} That's... a ring's light,{n} isn't iiit!?"
"Tch, did that bastard Ixion{n} beat us to it!?"
"Diana...{n} Is there no longer any way{n} for us to understand each other..."
"Reporting, sir!{n} We will reach Eglise shortly!"
"Lt. {hero:6}, sir."
"Yeah, I'm listening.{n} You're ready for battle?"
"Lt. {hero:6}! We're nearly at{n} Bertrand, where the ring{n} is said to be, sir."
"Battle preparations are complete, sir!"
"Good! Let's go."
"If HQ's information is right, the{n} ring should be at a place called{n} Dennison, up ahead, sir!"
"Good, let's hurry!{n} We can't let those women{n} get ahead of us!"
"Sir!"
"Current position confirmed, sir!"
"By what we learned in town, it is{n} about three more days to Clovis, sir."
"If the information is correct, that is."
"Yeah...{n} Well, even info like that{n} beats wandering aimlessly..."
"Let's go!"
"From what I heard at Airplane{n} Village, the ring should be at a{n} place called Cromwell, up ahead."
"Good. First we head for Cromwell."
"The Free Rhodes Army, huh.{n} Seems they were your comrades,{n} but they're fools..."
"Fight for their country, they say?"
"Soft thinking like that, leaning{n} on group mentality... there's no way{n} they could win a war."
"The weak, with no absolute desire{n} to hold them up, should never have{n} fought in the first place."
"Unlike me... or {hero:6}."
"So to win the Third Great Europea{n} War, the power of the island{n} is needed after all..."
"Every nation must be desperate.{n} To think rank-and-file soldiers{n} have already come this far."
"Well, thanks to that, we can get{n} word of the rings even in a{n} deserted land like this."
"Let's go. Next is Carrick."
"Just when I thought it was all{n} Machine Soldiers, now it's zombies?"
"Honestly, what a creepy island."
"Well, just see to it you don't{n} become a zombie yourself."
"Next time we come, we might see{n} the zombie of an old best friend."
"Those little girls just now...{n} I wonder if they knew this one.{n} We left them behind, though."
"If they can't get past a crisis{n} like that by themselves, they'd{n} never survive what's ahead anyway."
"If anything, they're better off dying{n} while the suffering's still small."
"Little girls like that, coming all{n} the way to the front line...{n} What a rotten world."
"The talk was that there's a ring{n} at a place called Forears, but..."
"That soldier just now had better{n} have been telling the truth."
"If they could lie in a spot like that,{n} I'd say Rheinmetall soldiers{n} weren't a lost cause yet."
"Well, they do say people turn{n} honest on the brink of death."
"That's one big door."
"And it's built a lot more solidly{n} than the ones down below."
"Looks like this is the{n} deepest part of the island..."
"Judging by the build, it seems we{n} can't go past here without{n} collecting every ring after all."
"What do we do, Ixion?{n} Looks like our rings alone{n} aren't enough."
"Let's see...{n} I suppose I'll have {hero:6}{n} hand the rest over."
"By force, if need be."
"Oh my...?"
"What is it... {name:6}?"
"The ring's light... has gone ouuut."
"...The stone tablet in the area{n} below was probably destroyed."
"Meaning we can't go{n} back down anymore."
"Oh no! How awfuuul!"
"That shelling just now has probably{n} left the area below in ruins.{n} There'd be no point going back."
"Suits us just fine as we are now,{n} doesn't it... having no way{n} to go but forward!"
"Just you wait, Ixion!"
"Diana..."
"{name:6}, use this."
"This is... an aerial photo?"
"Army issue. On this island, anything's{n} yours if you just pay. Hit up a bar{n} or two and you'll have one in no time."
"Mind you, a photo from this distance{n} tells you next to nothing."
"Still, we should be grateful just{n} to know the rough lay of the land."
"Diana, you really are{n} amaaazing after all."
"I hadn't given a single thought{n} to a map at aaall."
"Honestly, this missus...{n} Without even a map, where{n} did you plan on going?"
"Hee hee, sorryyy."
"Huh?"
"I said it before, didn't I?{n} 'If you just pay.' You don't{n} get anything for free!"
"Now then, I'll explain how{n} to use the map."
"Put the cursor on the place you want{n} to go and press the Circle button,{n} and the menu shows up."
"To organize the team or switch{n} equipment, choose 'Camp'."
"To move to the area under{n} the cursor, pick 'Move'{n} from the menu."
"To examine the area around your{n} current position, choose 'Search'."
"With 'Info', I report my scouting{n} results and the information{n} gathered in town."
"Moving between areas on the map takes{n} about one day, so watch it, or time'll{n} fly by before you know it."
"So hurry up and tell me{n} where you want to go.{n} You're the leader, after all!"
"Okaaay!"
"Oh my?"
"What is it?{n} Making a dopey noise like that..."
"I'm not dopey!{n} ...No, it's different from usual...{n} the rings' resonance won't stooo..."
"Wait, {name:6}!{n} The scenery around us!"
"My, my, my?"
"What on earth... is this!?"
"Could that have been{n} the last ring just now!?"
"The twelfth ring, you mean!? But we{n} should only have collected{n} {num:5,1} so far!?"
"It can't be!?"
"Could Diana's group have already{n} found the remaining rings!?"
"But... then...!?"
